extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to the Schmidt Science Fellows program (early-career researchers/postdoctoral candidates)
extracted.subtask_description: Information describing the qualities and selection focus for applicants to the Schmidt Science Fellows program — an interdisciplinary fellowship seeking early-career researchers who will broaden their disciplinary training and drive creative scientific solutions. Useful for prospective applicants preparing materials and deciding fit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trailblazer / pioneer / risk-taker with mission-driven ambition
rubrics_metrics.description: Fellows are trailblazers, pioneers, and risk-takers with an ambition to make the world a better place.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The homepage explicitly characterizes Fellows by these personal/attitudinal qualities, implying selection favors candidates who demonstrate boldness, initiative, and a clear ambition to effect positive global impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic excellence in natural sciences, mathematics, engineering, and computing
rubrics_metrics.description: We look for the brightest minds in the natural sciences, mathematics, engineering, and computing
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program targets high-achieving candidates from these specific fields, implying strong prior achievement or evidence of excellence in one of these disciplines is a baseline expectation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interest in broadening horizons to advance scientific discovery
rubrics_metrics.description: Who are interested in broadening their horizons to advance scientific discovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection favors applicants who explicitly express or demonstrate a desire to expand beyond their home discipline (e.g., through interdisciplinary training, collaboration, or plans) to accelerate discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ability to create novel ways of thinking and develop creative solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Science Fellows brings scientific disciplines together to create novel ways of thinking and develop creative solutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The program emphasizes interdisciplinary innovation — applicants should present evidence or plans for cross-disciplinary thinking and creative problem-solving that produce new approaches or solutions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to changing how science is done / breaking down interdisciplinary barriers
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission is to change how science is done. Working with the scientific community, we are helping break down the barriers to interdisciplinary science.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond individual excellence, the program values a broader commitment to transforming scientific practice toward greater interdisciplinarity; applicants who articulate systemic impact, collaboration, or leadership in interdisciplinary initiatives align with this mission.
